entries.0835ac795ab70ccd: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,174 million, up 5.8% from the previous fiscal year. By sales channel, the breakdown is ¥8,503 million to furniture retailers, ¥1,803 million to commercial facilities, ¥1,702 million to shops/showrooms, and ¥165 million to other channels.
entries.0be63067f28deacb: It is a channel that sells directly to general consumers at 6 Lean Rosé shops in Tokyo, Aichi, Osaka and Fukuoka prefectures, and sells through 4 showrooms in Hiroshima, Tokyo, Osaka and Aichi prefectures.
entries.2456bba654b4616d: The company has formulated a three-year medium-term management plan, “Creating Value for Dreams,” covering the fiscal years ended March 2027 to March 2029, and states that it will pursue the “deepening” of existing businesses and the “exploration” of new areas as twin drivers. For deepening, it cites higher added value for Serta, ligne roset and KING KOIL, strengthened collaboration with furniture retailers and CRM, and stepped-up efforts toward large consumer electronics retail chains. For exploration, it cites the discovery of new brands following KING KOIL, the expansion of the commercial facilities business, and OEM exports to Southeast Asian markets. The company also states that it will leverage the manufacturing advantages of its own factories to deploy the high-quality “Japan Fit” model globally.

entries.da30411eef1be0c7: This can be read from the exclusive license agreement with Serta, Inc. concluded in 1978 as printed in [Corporate History], and from the statements printed in [Business Overview] that licensed production allows fine adjustment of products to suit Japanese lifestyles and the environment, and that domestic production reduces import costs such as ocean freight and customs clearance fees.
